name: OnHomeroom Daily

schema.title: Chat channel
schema.description: The channel the chat task replies in

schema.title: Task gap (s)

schema.title: Max words per text
schema.description: Word cap the composer is told to respect

schema.title: Dwell chunk (s)
schema.description: App-try dwell reported per run_task call

schema.title: Dwell target (s)
schema.description: Total dwell per app before it counts as tried

schema.title: Quiet window (min)
schema.description: Stay quiet this long after your own channel message
